# Endfield Mod Loader SDK headers

`include/BetterEndfield/HookChain.h`, `ModuleApi.h` and `ThirdPartyModule.h` are copied unchanged from
[Dr-hydra/Endfield-Mod-Loader](https://github.com/Dr-hydra/Endfield-Mod-Loader), directory `include/BetterEndfield/`
as of commit `1134058`. The same three files ship as the Third-Party Module SDK 1.0.0 of Better Endfield 3.5.4.

They are licensed under AGPL-3.0-only, like Endfield Mod Loader. Copyright belongs to their authors.
